messages.text:
Evening all,

Game's on Thursday, pitch 3.

Different thing. My cousin Yaw is extending his visa and the solicitor wants a letter from his landlord saying he lives there. Luis you said on Saturday you'd had to get one for yours. Could he have a look at it so he knows what to ask his landlord for? Hamish copying you in because you said you'd read his over before he sends it.

K

I'd rather not send mine round, sorry. it's got Niamh's name on it, the flat, and my passport number. what it said was basically who lives there, since when, that the rent's paid and the landlord's fine with us staying. his solicitor will have a template that says the same thing.

thursday yes

Dear both,

Luis is quite right, and I would add that a letter copied from somebody else's tends to read like it, which is the last thing a caseworker should be given cause to notice.  When I taught we had a boy whose father wrote his references for the Saturday job in the same hand as his excuse notes, and the butcher spotted it before I did.

My offer stands.  If Yaw sends me whatever his landlord produces, I will read it for sense and spelling and nothing else; the law is his solicitor's business, not mine.

Yours, Hamish Fairweather

Fair enough, makes sense. I'll tell him to ask the solicitor and send it to you Hamish. Cheers both

K

truth.summary: Luis politely declined to share his own landlord letter with Kwame's cousin Yaw for a visa extension because it carries Niamh's name, the flat and his passport number; Hamish offered to proofread Yaw's own letter.
facts: Yaw, Kwame's cousin, is extending his visa and his solicitor wants a letter from his landlord.
Luis's landlord letter said who lives there, since when, that the rent is paid and the landlord is fine with them staying.
Hamish offered to read Yaw's letter for sense and spelling only.
Luis confirmed he could play on Thursday.

Mariana

I'd keep the Wednesday invoice sessions on while the researcher is on parental leave.
Only awkward bit is the calls already went out in their name. Can you take the first one so I can watch how you've been prompting people?

Jae

Hey Jae,

I'll take the first one on Wednesday at 10. I'd give people the same scruffy invoice as last week,, with the delivery line where the quantity is blank. That's how we found out people were going back to the job sheet before they felt safe sending anything. If we give them a clean invoice we'll get a clean run and learn almost nothing about that pause.

One thing from watching your session last week: you asked her where she'd put the discount and then pointed at the total when she stopped talking. Leave that silence a bit longer if you can. She went straight to the menu after that and I still don't know whether she'd been trying to do the maths or looking for a way out of the screen. If they say they've finished, get them to show you what they'd send to the customer. Last time what people called finished was sometimes just saved.

I'll stick to those prompts on the first call so you can hear them in context.

Thanks,
Luis

subject: Una mano con el catálogo de cerámica

people.name: Renata Robledo
people.relationship: Productora de una agencia que busca colaborar

style.register: De usted, cuenta cómo se hace el trabajo ahora
style.length: Varios párrafos con detalles del encargo

messages.text:
Hola, Luis:

Soy Renata Robledo, de Estudio Cauce. Estamos buscando a alguien de fuera para resolver el catálogo en línea de una marca de cerámica de Tonalá. Ya tenemos las fotos de casi todo, con excepción de las tazas grandes, que se vuelven a fotografiar porque salieron de otro color. Lo que le está costando trabajo al cliente es que vende el mismo plato en varios esmaltes y cada tienda le pide el catálogo ordenado de otra manera. Ahorita tienen un archivo distinto por tienda y cuando cambia un precio no saben si ya lo cambiaron en todos.

No necesitamos que tome las fotos ni que escriba las fichas. Las medidas y los precios los entrega la dueña del taller. Lo que nos gustaría encargarle es el diseño del catálogo para que se pueda actualizar una sola vez, más una versión que puedan imprimir si un comprador se las pide. Antes de pasarle el archivo principal necesito el visto bueno de la dueña porque trae precios de mayoreo. ¿Le interesaría entrar al proyecto en noviembre? Estamos proponiendo empezar la semana del 9, aunque todavía no amarramos la fecha con el taller.

Le agradezco,
Renata

Renata Robledo
Producción | Estudio Cauce

Hola, Renata:

Me interesa. Antes de confirmarle la semana del 9, ¿me podría compartir el presupuesto que tienen para diseño y una ficha de ejemplo, aunque sea sin precios? Quiero ver qué tanto cambia entre un esmalte y otro.

También me ayuda saber quién lo va a actualizar después de la entrega. Si lo hace la gente del taller lo planteo distinto que si lo hace su equipo.

Saludos,

Luis

Luis Cordero
Diseño de marca y producto
hola@luiscordero.example · +44 7700 900 418

truth.summary: Renata Robledo, de Estudio Cauce, propuso que Luis diseñara el catálogo de una marca de cerámica en noviembre y Luis espera el presupuesto, una ficha de ejemplo y saber quién lo mantendrá.
othersOwe: Renata Robledo: compartir el presupuesto de diseño, una ficha de ejemplo sin precios y decir quién actualizará el catálogo.

keyDates.what: Semana de inicio propuesta, sin confirmar

facts: El catálogo es para una marca de cerámica de Tonalá.
El encargo incluye una versión que se pueda imprimir y no incluye fotos ni redacción de fichas.
El taller tiene que autorizar que se comparta el archivo con precios de mayoreo.
